ORDINANCE LXVI OF

An Ordinance
further to amend Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part-I, 5th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
5-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Probation of Offenders
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3, Ordinance XLV of 1960

F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
5-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 3,
Ordinance XLV of 1960.--In the Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960 (XLV
of 1960), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance in section 3--
(a) in
subsection (1), clauses (c) and (d) shall be omitted; and
(b) in
subsection (3), the words "or a Sub-Divisional Magistrate" shall be
omitted.

3. Amendment of section 17,
Ordinance XLV of 1960.--In the said Ordinance, in section 17,--
(a) for the
words, comma and figure "Punjab Children Act, 1952" the words comma,
figures and brackets "Punjab Children Ordinance, 1983 Pb. Ord. XXII of
1983)" shall be substituted; and
(b) for the
words, comma and figure "Punjab Youthful Offenders Act, 1952" the
words, comma, figures and brackets "Punjab Youthful Offenders Ordinance,
1983 (Pb. Ord. XXIII of 1983)" shall be substituted.
